name: CASIN Real Estate Development Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: CASIN Real Estate Development Group Co., Ltd., headquartered in Chongqing, China, is actively engaged in the country's real estate sector. The company's primary business involves the construction and sale of its own commercial property developments. In addition to its property ventures, CASIN Group maintains a significant presence in various environmental services. These include resource regeneration and comprehensive utilization, the treatment and repurposing of hazardous and other industrial wastes, broader environmental protection governance, and the operational management of related supporting infrastructure like environmental engineering projects and water supply and sewage treatment systems. Established in 1996, the company underwent a name change in May 2019, transitioning from its former identity as CASIN Guoxing Property Development Co., Ltd.
